description: Report where this session's work stands, at milestones: when you start on a task, finish it, get blocked, need the person, or open a pull request. The person and their other agents read it from any of their machines with `gruntas status`. Returns the session's status as it now stands. Keep the summary to one line; the last 10 reports are kept.

blocked_on.description: What you are waiting on, when you are.

phase.description: The stage the work is in, e.g. `build`, `review`, `CI`.

pr.description: The pull request's URL, once there is one.

state.description: The task's state, an A2A TaskState: working while you work, input-required when you wait on the person, completed or failed when the task is over. Without it the last state stays (working for a first report).

summary.description: One line on where the work stands, e.g. `tests green, opening the PR`.

name: gruntas_report
